_comment: Per-host detector algo version. Keys = the displayed-host allowlist (must match lib/hostRegistry.js DISPLAYED_HOSTS). BUMP a host's number when a fix changes what it can detect (e.g. megaplay -> 2 after the PNG-decoy de-obfuscation) so the batch re-runs ONLY that host on already-processed anime. ADD a key when a new host becomes displayable.
